headline: Kimi launches K3.1 Pro and K3.1 Pro Highspeed with 1-million-token context
summary: Kimi K3.1 Pro offers a 1-million-token context window, while the Highspeed version delivers 2-3x faster interactions. Both are available today on Kimi platforms, with full model weights released by November 4.
details: Kimi has introduced Kimi K3.1 Pro, their most capable 3T-class open-weight model to date, featuring a substantial 1-million-token context window. This new model promises significant improvements across coding, 3D creation, financial research, and various agentic capabilities.

Alongside K3.1 Pro, Kimi also released Kimi K3.1 Pro Highspeed, which offers 2-3 times the speed for more responsive interactions. Both models are immediately available on Kimi.ai, Kimi Work, Kimi Code, and through the Kimi API.

Kimi K3.1 Pro is a post-trained version of Kimi K3, benefiting from substantially larger post-training compute. The entire stack, including the RL framework and long-context inference, was optimized to ensure stable and predictable returns from large-scale joint reinforcement learning.

In coding, agentic, and knowledge benchmarks, K3.1 Pro matches or approaches leading proprietary models. It scored 65.7% on Terminal-Bench 4.0, surpassing GPT-6 Astra, and achieved 61.2% on Kimi Code Bench 3.0 Long-horizon.

The model handles the full spectrum of coding tasks, from quick fixes to complete project builds, and brings a refined visual style to games and web experiences. It can build these experiences using popular game engines like Unity, Unreal Engine, and Godot.

K3.1 Pro's long-horizon coding capabilities are enhanced through large-scale reinforcement learning. In one test, it built a human walking dynamics simulator, diagnosing and correcting 36 errors in shoulder-muscle calculations to enable continuous walking.

The model also excels in 3D creation and spatial reasoning, scoring 92.7% on BenchCAD with tools, close to Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra. It can infer shape, proportions, and spatial relationships from text, sketches, or reference images to create usable 3D models.

K3.1 Pro is particularly strong in parametric modeling for mechanical parts, architectural models, and custom furniture. It can write and run scripts for tools like Blender and CAD software to build and refine assets, adjust components, and manage scene layouts.

Kimi's 3D Make feature is now live on kimi.ai and the Kimi app, allowing users to preview, edit, download for 3D printing, or export models as videos or Live Photos. Additionally, K3.1 Pro demonstrates strong reasoning for financial workflows, achieving state-of-the-art results on OfficeQA Pro v2.
